thread:
incident_bot: :rotating_light: Paging: High error rate and throughput degradation detected for /v1/embeddings (eu-west-1). p95 latency spiked to ~2.1s, overall success rate dropped to 85% (baseline 99.9%).

maya: seeing the alert in Grafana. errors are 502/503 from the inference backend, not LB. Multiple customers reporting increased RTTs.

aj: on it, switching to emergency channel. maya — can you post the top 3 affected customers (rough IDs) so CSMs can start outreach?

maya: 
- cust-redwood-ai (high traffic embeddings)
- cust-docsearch (trial)
- cust-marketlytics (scheduled batch jobs)
I put dashboard links in the thread: https://grafana.internal/r/embeddings-eu

sre-bot: automated runbook triggered: "embeddings-high-latency-v2". Recommended first steps: 1) check model variant memory pressure, 2) validate horizontal scaling, 3) fallback to smaller quantized variant.

maya: checked pods — memory pressure on model-shard-2, OOMKilled historical restarts ~3 in last 10m. KV cache size growing for long prefixes.

aj: starting a conservative mitigation: routing 25% of incoming traffic for embeddings to eu-west-2 (fallback region) and enabling prefix-cache-eviction policy. Applying now.

platform_log_bot: routing policy update: roll traffic 25% -> eu-west-2 (sha: a3f9b2c).

maya: applying prefix eviction config: `cache.max_prefix_tokens=1024` and `kv_cache_eviction=LRU`. Pushing config to runtime.

ops_lead_kate: please prepare a brief status for status.redwood.ai. We need customers informed ASAP. Minimal: what happened, who affected, mitigation in place, ETA for resolution.

cm_ellen: I'll draft a customer notification template. prefer conservative wording: impact on embedding requests in eu-west-1, degraded performance and occasional 5xx; mitigations: traffic rerouted and config changes; next update in 30m.

maya: after eviction, error rate dropped to 92% success and p95 to ~1.35s. Still above SLO but improved. Continuing to scale up worker pool.

aj: scaling dedicated pool: `scale set embeddings-eu workers=+10` — request submitted, expected active in ~90s.

platform_log_bot: scale operation completed. Pool size increased by 10 nodes.

maya: post-scale numbers: success rate 97.4%, p95 820ms. Good signal. We'll keep traffic split for 15m to ensure stability, then gradually shift back.

aj: initiating rolling rollback to previous model-variant for any nodes still running variant v3-opt that shows memory leak. command: `deploy rollback embeddings:v3-opt -> v3-stable` (safe rollback).

incident_bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3347, severity: sev2. Primary symptom: eu-west-1 embeddings latency and increased 5xx.

ops_lead_kate: status.redwood.ai entry draft (internal): "We are investigating increased latency and error rates for embeddings in eu-west-1. Traffic has been partially rerouted to eu-west-2 and additional capacity added. Customers may see intermittent 5xx and higher latencies. Engineers are monitoring; mitigation in place. Next update in 30 minutes or earlier if status changes."

cm_ellen: customer-facing email (short): "We're aware of service degradation for embeddings in our EU region (eu-west-1). We've rerouted traffic and added capacity; most requests should be returning to normal. We're continuing to monitor and will follow up once fully resolved. If you're seeing persistent issues, please reply to this message and include request IDs. — Redwood Inference SRE"

maya: note for postmortem — investigate kv cache growth for long-running sessions, possibly a regression in LRU bookkeeping introduced in v3-opt. Collect heap profiles and model runtime logs: `kubectl logs -c inference model-shard-2 --since=15m`.

aj: handing off to night oncall (maya -> aj). Summary for oncall: mitigation active (25% reroute, cache eviction, +10 nodes, rollback started), immediate metrics improved to p95 820ms and 97.4% success, incident INC-2026-3347 created. Next: confirm rollback fully completed, validate no new OOMs, keep traffic split for 15m.

maya: thanks — I'll add heap dumps and attach to incident ticket. Leaving now.

aj: acknowledged, taking over. I'll update status page in 20m with full numbers.

ops_lead_kate: internal comms template for engineers to share with PMs: "We detected service degradation impacting embeddings in eu-west-1 due to memory pressure from model variant v3-opt. Immediate mitigations: prefix cache eviction, partial rerouting to eu-west-2, scale-up of pool, and safe rollback to v3-stable. Customer impact: intermittent 5xx and elevated p95. Current status: improved but monitoring. Investigation ongoing. Ticket: INC-2026-3347."

platform_log_bot: note: saved heap profiles to s3://redwood-logs/incidents/INC-2026-3347/heap-dumps/1782500000.tar.gz

aj: leaving a sticky: if we see recurrence within 2hrs, auto-evict long prefixes >4096 and consider forcing quantized variant for heavy customers.

incident_bot: Next scheduled update reminder in 20m.

cm_ellen: I'll send the customer email now and CC CSMs for the three affected accounts. Template posted above.

aj: thanks everyone. I'll post a final "mitigation stable" update when traffic is fully shifted back and p95 < 600ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows.

platform_log_bot: log summary appended to incident: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-3347

aj: (closing note) leaving monitoring on. ping me if things slide back. :phone:
